ai.purpose: Provide a regime-aware, amplitude-first interface to Quantum Mechanics as a coherence grammar of operators, superposition, and measurement.

identity.name: Quantum Mechanics
identity.summary: A coherence-level grammar describing amplitudes, operators, superposition, and measurement in regimes where distinctions are not yet stable.

lineage.notes: Quantum Mechanics describes coherence, amplitudes, and measurement. It is a grammar of possibilities, not a literal ontology of waves or particles.

operators.description: Operators describe how amplitudes evolve, interfere, and collapse into distinctions under measurement.

risks: interpreting collapse as a physical event
boundaries: QM is a coherence grammar, not ontology
QM yields to QFT in R2→R3

cross_module.integration_notes: QM integrates cleanly with RTT engines as a coherence grammar operating in R1→R2, bridging primitive amplitudes and excitation-level QFT.
